scenes.text: Imagine looking at your family, your friends, and every single person you have ever met, and realizing you are suddenly looking at the very last of your kind.
Around seventy thousand years ago, this nightmare actually happened when a massive supervolcano erupted, plunging the planet into a brutal, dark volcanic winter that lasted for nearly a decade.

With plants dying and temperatures freezing, scientists estimate that the global human population plummeted to just a few thousand struggling individuals, leaving us hanging on by a microscopic thread.

Every single human alive today shares the DNA of those brave survivors who somehow managed to crawl out of the dark, so would you have survived this apocalypse? Let me know in the comments and follow for more insane history!
